quick_notes.title: Bharathidasan (1891-1964)
quick_notes.detail: Real name: Kanakasubburatnam. Titles : Pavendar, Puratchikavi. Famous works : Pandiyan Parisu, Azhagin Sirippu, Kudumba Vilakku. He was a follower of Bharathiyar and a major voice in the Dravidian movement.

quick_notes.title: Kavimani Desigavinayagam Pillai
quick_notes.detail: Famous for "Asia Jothi" (Life of Buddha) and "Marumakkal Vazhi Maanmiyam". He is known for simple and sweet poems for children.

topic_title: TNPSC General Tamil: Modern Literature & Poets
lesson_intro: Today we move to the 'Modern Era' of Tamil poetry—the period of social reform and national awakening. We start with the 'Mahakavi' Bharathiyar, who revolutionized Tamil poetry with simple language and powerful themes of freedom and equality. We also study Bharathidasan, the 'Pavendar', who carried forward the Dravidian and social reform ideals. For TNPSC, knowing their works, pseudonyms, and famous lines is crucial. Let's master the 'Poets of the People' today.
